scripts.build:all: pnpm -r run build && pnpm run build && cargo build && cargo build --manifest-path examples/tauri-app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.build:release: pnpm -r run build && pnpm run build && cargo build --release && cargo build --manifest-path examples/tauri-app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --release
scripts.format: prettier --write 'guest-js/**/*.ts' && cargo fmt && swiftformat ios/ && ktlint -F 'android/src/**/*.kt'
scripts.format:check: prettier --check 'guest-js/**/*.ts' && cargo fmt --check && swiftformat --lint ios/ && ktlint 'android/src/**/*.kt'
scripts.lint: eslint && cargo clippy -- -D warnings && swiftlint && ktlint 'android/src/**/*.kt'
scripts.lint:fix: eslint --fix && cargo clippy --fix -- -D warnings && swiftlint --fix && ktlint -F 'android/src/**/*.kt'
scripts.format:all: pnpm -r run format && pnpm run format
scripts.format:check:all: pnpm -r run format:check && pnpm run format:check
scripts.lint:all: pnpm -r run lint && pnpm run lint
scripts.lint:fix:all: pnpm -r run lint:fix && pnpm run lint:fix
